en: Job 41

p.src: 1  “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

en: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
u.src: 1  “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

en: 41:1 Leviathan is a name for a crocodile or similar creature.

p.src: 2  Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

en: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
u.src: 2  Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

p.src: 3  Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

en: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
u.src: 3  Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

p.src: 4  Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

en: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
u.src: 4  Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

p.src: 5  Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

en: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
u.src: 5  Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

p.src: 6  Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

en: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
u.src: 6  Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

p.src: 7  Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

en: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
u.src: 7  Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

p.src: 8  Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

en: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
u.src: 8  Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

p.src: 9  Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?
u.src: 9  Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

p.src: 10  None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

en: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
u.src: 10  None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

p.src: 11  Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

en: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
u.src: 11  Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

p.src: 12  “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

en: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
u.src: 12  “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

p.src: 13  Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

en: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?
u.src: 13  Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

p.src: 14  Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

en: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
u.src: 14  Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

p.src: 15  Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

en: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.
u.src: 15  Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

p.src: 16  One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
u.src: 16  One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

p.src: 17  They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

en: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.
u.src: 17  They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

p.src: 18  His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

en: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
u.src: 18  His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

p.src: 19  Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

en: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.
u.src: 19  Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

p.src: 20  Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

en: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
u.src: 20  Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

p.src: 21  His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

en: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
u.src: 21  His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

p.src: 22  There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

en: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
u.src: 22  There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

p.src: 23  The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.
u.src: 23  The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

p.src: 24  His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

en: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.
u.src: 24  His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

p.src: 25  When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

en: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.
u.src: 25  When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

p.src: 26  If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

en: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
u.src: 26  If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

p.src: 27  He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

en: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.
u.src: 27  He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

p.src: 28  The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

en: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.
u.src: 28  The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

p.src: 29  Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

en: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.
u.src: 29  Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

p.src: 30  His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

en: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
u.src: 30  His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

p.src: 31  He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

en: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
u.src: 31  He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

p.src: 32  He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

en: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.
u.src: 32  He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

p.src: 33  On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

en: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.
u.src: 33  On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

p.src: 34  He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”

en: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”
u.src: 34  He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”
